audit_items.proof_trace: TOCTOU race between cache check (L157) and cache set (L42 in subscriber). Two concurrent P2P messages with identical (slot, proposer_index, index) can both pass the hasSeenDataColumnIndex check before either sets the cache, causing duplicate sidecar forwarding and state processing.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker broadcasts duplicate data column sidecars concurrently to multiple peers. Both validation paths check cache simultaneously (both see 'not seen'), both pass validation, both call dataColumnSubscriber, causing duplicate ReceiveDataColumn processing and potential state inconsistency.
